vent.name: Ventilation House
vent.description: Fresh air keeps every crew productive. Upgrade when air demand exceeds supply.

lift.name: Ore Lift
lift.description: Carry more material to the surface each second. Slow lifts limit the whole mine.

depot.name: Surface Depot
depot.description: Store more uncollected resources. Full depots pause production without losing supplies.

tools.name: Tool Workshop
tools.description: Sharper picks improve every digger's output. Check lift and air capacity before investing.

smelter.name: Ramforge Smelter
smelter.description: Forge collected metal seams and coal into tradeable bars, or refine ordinary ore for Mine Gold. Higher levels speed up bar batches.

assay.name: Crystal Assay House
assay.description: Improve gem recovery and unlock the Gem Survey boost.

pump.name: Drainage Station
pump.description: Pump water from deep workings. Required from shaft four; improves deep extraction.

drill.name: Clockwork Drillworks
drill.description: Powered excavation boosts all crews, but increases air demand.

biomes.name: Mosslit Entrance
biomes.lore: Roots thread through the first seams. Your first ram crew turns an old tunnel into a working mine.

biomes.name: Copper Galleries
biomes.lore: Copper veins glitter beside old support beams. A drainage station and assay house become useful here.

biomes.name: Amethyst Grotto
biomes.lore: Violet crystals light the rock. Mechanised drills need a larger supply of fresh air.

biomes.name: Flooded Sapphire
biomes.lore: Blue seams run beside underground streams. Pump upgrades keep the lower galleries working.

biomes.name: Emberstone Hollow
biomes.lore: Warm mineral seams colour the stone. Dense deposits reward a balanced lift and mining network.

biomes.name: Starlight Bedrock
biomes.lore: The deepest seams shine like a night sky. A complete twenty-shaft operation is a long-term account achievement.
